sections.body: We all have feelings. 😊 happy, 😢 sad, 😠 angry, 😨 scared.
All feelings are OK. It's what we DO with them that matters.
When we feel big feelings, we can take a deep breath and tell a grown-up.
Make a happy face, a sad face, then a surprised face in the mirror!
Name feelings out loud ('You look frustrated'). Children learn emotional words by hearing them in real moments.

quiz.q: Your tower falls down and you feel cross. What can you do?
hints: Breathing slowly helps us calm down.
When you feel cross about a lost game, a big breath helps. Same here!
quiz.explain: A big breath helps you feel calm again. 🌬️

hints: A happy mouth goes up in a smile.
😢 has a tear. Which one is smiling?
